text:
Hi, I’m Mina Castellan, and I’m passionate, hard-working, and focused on delivering clean, accurate lead lists that are ready to use right away.

I can help you build a list of 100 influencers in New York, USA, with the details you need: company name, website, email, phone number, and address. With 5 years of experience in data analysis, SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization, I’m used to gathering information carefully, organizing it clearly, and making sure the final output is structured and easy to work with.

For a project with Juniper & Ash Home, I built customer segments from Shopify order exports using Google Sheets and Looker Studio, then fed those segments to the email tool. One result from that work was that the top segment represented 9% of customers and 41% of revenue, and the email revenue increased by 19%. That project required careful data handling, consistency checks, and clear formatting—skills that also apply well to building a reliable influencer lead list.

For your project, I would focus on accuracy, completeness, and consistency across every entry. I understand that lead lists are most useful when the information is clean and well organized, so I would make sure each record is easy to review and ready for outreach or CRM upload.

I can work efficiently, handle data cleanup when needed, and present the results in a simple format that matches your requirements. If there are any preferences for how you want the list structured, I’m happy to follow them closely.

I’d be glad to help you with this project and deliver a strong, usable list of 100 influencers in New York.
